lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p1-2 - A Listen and say

details: Listen and say checks understanding of continent names and their sounds. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, clear sounds on longer names, and confident repetition.
“I met some new friends but I forgot where they live! Can you help me remember? Let’s listen and look at the map together”

Look for correct matching of countries to continents, clear pronunciation of the model sentence, accurate use of the target vocabulary, and turn taking.

lessonPlan.topic: Break [10m] - C. Listen. Then ask and Answer

details:
Listen checks understanding of descriptive vocabulary related to the five senses.
Ask and answer gives students controlled practice using the target question form to ask and respond to simple questions.
Look for accurate use of question forms, clear descriptive answers with correct sense verbs (sounds/looks/feels/smells/tastes), and consistent reference to details in the picture.
“I bet each place in the world looks, sounds and even smells different! Let’s learn some words we could use to describe places we visit.”

Look and learn introduces units of measurement through simple visuals and supports recognition of when weight, distance or length is being shown.
Look for correct identification of each measurement type, accurate naming of units, and reference to the images to explain what is being measured.
“I really want to travel to countries thousands of miles away!”
